preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.
The altitude of each vertex is between 1 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: The output is the maximum possible number of edges in the graph for each test case.
postconditions.description: The output must represent the maximum number of edges that can be added to the graph without violating the given constraints.
